senses.gloss: लिख्य m. and f(आ). id. (also a measure of weight), ŚārṅgS.; Bhpr.; AgP.
लिख्य See col. 1.
लिख् [cf. Gk. ἐρείκω; Lith. rë́kti, ‘to cut’.]
लिख mfn. scratching, writing
a writer &c., Pāṇ. iii, 1, 135.
लिखन n. the act of scratching, furrowing &c., Kāv.; Sāh.
writing, inscribing, MārkP.; Pañcar.
scarifying, W.
a written document, ib.
लिखित॑ mfn. scratched, scraped, scarified, AV. &c. &c.
written, Pañcat.; Kathās. (= mentioned, Inscr.)
drawn, delineated, sketched, painted, Kāv.; VarBṛS.
लिखित॑ m. N. of a Ṛṣi and author of a work on law (frequently mentioned together with Śaṅkha q.v.), MBh. (IW. 302)
N. of Śaṅkha's brother (whose hands were cut off by king Su-dyumna as a punishment for having eaten some fruit in Śaṅkha's hermitage without leave, described in MBh. xii, 668 &c.)
लिखित॑ n. a writing, written document, scripture, Yājñ., Sch. (IW. 297).
लिखित—त्व n. the condition of being written down, Yājñ., Sch.
लिखित—पाठ m. the reading of written words, learning from books, Sarvad.
लिखित—पाठक m. one who reads from manuscript, Śikṣ.
लिखित—रुद्र m. N. of a grammarian, Cat.
लिखित—स्मृति f. N. of a law-book (cf. above).
लिखितव्य mfn. to be painted, Śak.
लिखितृ m. a painter, Viddh.
लिखिखिल्ल (?) m. a peacock, L.
